current_formulation: LLM use deferred to query time, with noun-phrase extraction at index time (LazyGraphRAG, 2024).

steps.formulation: GraphRAG: global questions over a corpus treated as query-focused summarization, answered from an LLM-built entity graph with pregenerated community summaries.
steps.quote: inherently a query-focused summarization (QFS) task, rather than an explicit retrieval task.

steps.formulation: HippoRAG: LLM-extracted graph with Personalized PageRank for single-step retrieval.
steps.quote: HippoRAG synergistically orchestrates LLMs, knowledge graphs, and the Personalized PageRank algorithm.

steps.formulation: LightRAG: graph structures in text indexing, dual-level retrieval, incremental updates.
steps.quote: incorporates graph structures into text indexing and retrieval processes

steps.formulation: LazyGraphRAG: noun-phrase extraction at index time, LLM use deferred to query time.
steps.quote: defers all LLM use until query time
